# Knowledge Catalog

> Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog tools, agents, and samples for data metadata management, enrichment, and AI-powered search.

GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog (vendored under /srv/dev/knowledge-catalog) is a reference/demo repository for **Knowledge Catalog** (formerly Dataplex), Google Cloud's AI-powered data catalog and metadata management platform.

## Knowledge index — start here

- [.okf/index.md](.okf/index.md): in-repo knowledge catalog: what this repo is, structure, conventions, pointers.
- [Enrichment Agent](.okf/enrichment-agent.md)
- [mdcode - Metadata as Code toolbox](.okf/mdcode.md)
- [Open Knowledge Format Reference Agent](.okf/okf-reference-agent.md)

## Repo entry points

- [README.md](README.md): project overview, install, usage.
